title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Blackcurrant Passion Ice 50/50 Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Blackcurrant Passion Ice by Doozy Infinity offers a striking combination of rich, dark fruit and exotic sweetness. Jammy Blackcurrant brings a deep, almost syrupy base, while Passionfruit cuts through with its tart, tropical character. The addition of Ice rounds out the flavour, delivering a cool, breezy finish that keeps the fruit blend tasting well-defined from first puff to last. Blended at a balanced 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping using pod systems , vape pens , and vape starter kits . Each 120ml shortfill bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, with space to add two 10ml nic shots to reach your preferred strength. Part of the Doozy Infinity ‘Podfill’ range, these e-liquids deliver vibrant flavour and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, ideal for those who want longer-lasting 50/50 blends in refillable MTL devices.
